src.core.statistics.delay_seasonal_distribution.calculate_mean_arrival_delay_distribution_per_month(departure_station: str, arrival_station: str, selected_month: int, historical_years: list[int], data_df: pandas.DataFrame) → dict[str, float | int | None]¶

Return different statistics about the mean train delays at arrival for a specific calendar month of the year and a specific railway line.

The distribution is calculated using the monthly mean of arrival delays from the selected historical years.

Statistics are calculated depending on the number of available and valid observations:

  • 0 observations: all distribution statistics are NaN

  • 1 observation: median only

  • 2 to 4 observations: minimum, median and maximum

  • 5+ observations: minimum, Q1, median, Q3 and maximum

The function also returns the total number of delayed trains at arrival, which have been used for the calculation of the means. This number is returned only if values are valid and available. The function returns also the number of observations (number of historical years)

Unavailable statistics are represented by NaN. The total number of delayed trains at arrival is None when it cannot be determined.

Parameters:

  • departure_station (str) – departure railway station

  • arrival_station (str) – arrival railway station

  • selected_month (int) – calendar month (1 to 12)

  • historical_years (list[int]) – past years selected for calculations, which should be available in the dataset

  • data_df (pd.DataFrame) – DataFrame containing the preprocessed data

Returns:

  • minimum: minimum of monthly mean delay (minutes)

  • q1: first quartile of monthly mean delay (minutes)

  • median: median of monthly mean delay (minutes)

  • q3: third quartile of monthly mean delay (minutes)

  • maximum: maximum of monthly mean delay (minutes)

  • number_historical_year_observations: number of

    valid observations (historical years)

  • sum_arr_delayed_trains: total number of delayed trains

    associated with the valid monthly mean arrival delays

Return type:

dict[str, float | int | None]

src.core.statistics.delay_seasonal_distribution.generate_historical_monthly_mean_arrival_delay_distribution_dataframe(departure_station: str, arrival_station: str, start_month: int, end_month: int, historical_years: list[int], data_df: pandas.DataFrame) → pandas.DataFrame¶
Generate a dataframe containing statistics of the mean train delays at arrival

for each calendar month of the selected period and selected railway line.

Statistics are calculated from the monthly mean arrival delays observed during the selected historical years.

Parameters:

  • departure_station (str) – departure railway station

  • arrival_station (str) – arrival railway station

  • start_month (int) – first month of the selected period (included)

  • end_month (int) – last month of the selected period (included)

  • historical_years (list[int]) – past years selected for calculations, which should be available in the dataset

  • data_df (pd.DataFrame) – DataFrame containing the preprocessed data

Returns:

A DataFrame containing one row per calendar month
of the selected period, with the following columns:

month : calendar month (1 to 12) minimum: minimum of monthly mean delay (minutes) q1: first quartile of monthly mean delay (minutes) median: median of monthly mean delay (minutes) q3: third quartile of monthly mean delay (minutes) maximum: maximum of monthly mean delay (minutes) number_historical_year_observations: number of

valid observations (historical years)

sum_arr_delayed_trains: total number of delayed trains

associated with the valid monthly mean arrival delays

Return type:

pd.DataFrame

src.core.statistics.delay_seasonal_distribution.get_monthly_mean_arrival_delay_global_dataframe(departure_station: str, arrival_station: str, start_month: int, end_month: int, years_list: list[int], data_df: pandas.DataFrame, actual_year: int = 2026) → pandas.DataFrame¶
Generate a DataFrame combining historical statistics of mean arrival delays

with the monthly mean arrival delays of the selected actual year, for a specific railway line and period of months.

Historical statistics are calculated from the selected past years, excluding the actual year if present in the list. The actual year’s observations are then added to the historical distribution for each calendar month.

Months without valid observations from the actual year are kept in the DataFrame, with NaN values for the corresponding metrics.

Parameters:

  • departure_station (str) – departure railway station

  • arrival_station (str) – arrival railway station

  • start_month (int) – first month of the selected period (included)

  • end_month (int) – last month of the selected period (included)

  • years_list (list[int]) – years selected for the historical calculations, excluding the actual year

  • data_df (pd.DataFrame) – DataFrame containing the preprocessed data

  • actual_year (int, optional) – year whose observations are compared with the historical distribution. Defaults to 2026.

Returns:

a DataFrame containing one row per calendar month

of the selected period, with the following columns:

Historical statistics:

month: calendar month (1 to 12) minimum: minimum of monthly mean arrival delay (minutes) q1: first quartile of monthly mean arrival delay (minutes) median: median of monthly mean arrival delay (minutes) q3: third quartile of monthly mean arrival delay (minutes) maximum: maximum of monthly mean arrival delay (minutes) number_historical_year_observations: number of valid

historical observations

sum_arr_delayed_trains: total number of delayed trains

associated with valid historical monthly mean delays

Actual year :
mean_arrival_delay_actual_year: mean arrival delay (minutes)

for the corresponding month of the actual year

number_arr_delayed_trains_actual_year: number of delayed trains

at arrival for the corresponding month of the actual year

Return type:

pd.DataFrame
